body:
Last night I decided to try Molly (MDMA)....
The first few hours were fun, I was energetic and happy and talkative. A small line was snorted followed in the next couple hours by an unknown amount of hits via a pipe.
Each time I would smoke I would feel a tingle from the base of my spine across my scalp. I did tend to shake my leg every once and awhile without realizing it and often lost my train of thought or got distracted. During these times I would jump from topic to topic as I remember original thoughts.
Now as fun as that was, I've definitely decided that this is not the drug for me. I've decided to name this the hangover from hell. Severe anxiety, vomiting, blurred vision and a momentary loss of consciousness due to panic and stress of outside situation. As of this moment I've been awake for 27 hours and still cannot sleep. This may partially be due to the anxiety but nevertheless it is quite vexing because I am most certainly exhausted. Between the rush of chemicals in my brain and the multiple instances of tears being shed I would very much like to sleep.
